create_qwen2vl_image_processor: create a Qwen2VLImageProcessor instance with custom min_pixels, max_pixels, and patch_size settings
run_smart_resize: run smart_resize to scale image dimensions divisible by patch factor within min/max pixel constraints
build_preprocess_pipeline: build image preprocessing pipeline that resizes, normalizes, and produces pixel_values with image_grid_thw metadata
get_number_of_image_patches: get the number of image patches for a given height and width using smart_resize and patch/merge sizes
group_images_by_shape: group images by spatial shape to batch process images of identical dimensions together
